scope_note: Route A exploratory pilot, 5-paper corpus. This schema revision aligns evidence operationalization with the user-confirmed formula scope; it does not change the overall research objective, the RQ hierarchy, or the three candidate gap/frontier directions. D01/D02 use clear natural-language evidence. D03 equation-type coding is out of scope; this does not remove the broader RQ1 or claim equations are absent. Preserve original PDFs, Step 1 text, evidence blocks, and risk metadata.

common_record_fields.primary_label: string, required (controlled label or fallback state)
common_record_fields.secondary_labels: array[string], optional (multi-select dimensions only: D08, D10 in v1.2; D03 is a scope-status record, not a multi-select analytic dimension)
common_record_fields.evidence_ids: array[string], required unless primary_label in [Not_Stated_In_Text, Evidence_Unavailable, Out_Of_Scope_Formula_Only, Not_Analyzed_Out_Of_Scope]
common_record_fields.verbatim_quote: string, required for text-supported labels; may be empty for [Not_Stated_In_Text, Evidence_Unavailable, Out_Of_Scope_Formula_Only, Not_Analyzed_Out_Of_Scope]
common_record_fields.equation_detail: null/not used in schema v1.2; formula transcription, equation numbers, variables, structure, and derivation are outside scope
common_record_fields.agent_a_model_call_id: string, required for analyzed D01/D02 and inherited D04-D10 records; null for the D03 Not_Analyzed_Out_Of_Scope status record (no extraction call is made)
common_record_fields.agent_b_review: object, filled in for analyzed records by the documented review workflow; null for D03 Not_Analyzed_Out_Of_Scope status record

D01.name: 水-电耦合方向（文本证据版）
D01.interpretation_note: Parallel_No_Explicit_Textual_Coupling_Statement means no explicit natural-language coupling direction was located in relevant text; it does not imply absence of equations or mathematical coupling.

D02.name: 厂内冷却水建模（文本证据版）
D02.interpretation_note: Model inclusion must be supported by clear natural-language description. A background/example/limitation mention alone is not an in-plant cooling model. A generic water-supply dependency link to a power plant may be modeled without a cooling-specific process; in that case record both facts, and do not interpret a D02 non-cooling-specific label as absence of all water-to-power dependence. PDF-03 remains a boundary case requiring domain adjudication before freezing.
D02.boundary_rule: If a generic multilayer dependency model states that a power plant receives water from a water facility and gives cooling only as an example, but does not describe cooling-specific demand, process, state, constraint, control target, or performance measure, classify D02 by the cooling-specific threshold (provisionally Mentioned_Only_Not_Modeled) and explicitly note that the generic water-to-power dependency is modeled. Do not generalize the D02 label to absence of all interdependence.

D03.name: 核心耦合方程类型（当前范围外状态记录）
D03.interpretation_note: This status excludes equation-type coding only. It does not delete RQ1, candidate gap 3-1, or imply that papers lack equations; textual evidence about cooling-water/model descriptions remains available under D02.

version_history.note: Initial frozen version. Used to produce all 50 verified records (B001-PDF-01..05) under this version; immutable snapshot preserved at schema_v1.0_frozen_snapshot.json. Traceable per-call via model_call_manifest.jsonl schema_version field (all 18 entries = v1.0).

Same-day revision after Step 5/6 findings (see error_analysis_v1.md §2.1/§2.2 and synthesis_v1.md cluster B discussion). Two changes: (1) Added D03 label 'Topological_Dependency_Equation' to cover explicit graph-topological binary dependency equations (e.g. B001-PDF-03 Eqs.1-5) that no v1.0 D03 label described. (2) Added prose-only 'keyword trap' negative-example guidance to the D05 and D06 codebook sections (schema_v2_D01-D10_codebook.md); no controlled label values changed for D05/D06. Existing v1.0 verified records are NOT retroactively modified; see codebook changelog for full defect description and non-retroactivity policy.

Scope-operationalization revision after user confirmed equation transcription/derivation is outside scope. The overall research objective, original RQ hierarchy, and three candidate gap/frontier directions are preserved. D01/D02 are operationalized from clear natural-language evidence; D03 equation-type coding is not performed and is excluded from findings/metrics, without deleting RQ1 or the broader model/coupling research goal. See schema_v1.2_RQ1_text_scope_revision.md and the 2026-10-08 goal-alignment correction. A source-based same-session review of original PDFs added a D02 boundary rule distinguishing generic power-plant water dependency from cooling-specific process modeling; PDF-03 remains a provisional boundary case, not independently adjudicated. See D02_v1.2_original_pdf_targeted_review_same_session_2026-10-08.md.

research_questions.RQ3: 级联故障后果是否从物理网络服务损失延伸到人口、关键民生设施和社会脆弱性？ (Unchanged; linked to candidate gap 5-1.)

dimension_disposition_labels.Not_Analyzed_Out_Of_Scope: Dimension excluded from analysis by design; not a substantive finding.
dimension_disposition_labels.Out_Of_Scope_Formula_Only: A D01/D02 judgment would depend on equation/math inspection rather than clear text; do not infer, and do not call it absent or unavailable.

research_program.overall_objective: Learn from literature in the field to propose three candidate research gaps/frontier directions, formulate research questions/hypotheses from them, and use evidence-grounded LLM analysis to test whether the pilot corpus supports, contradicts, or leaves them unresolved.

candidate_gap_hypotheses_preserved.summary: More detailed in-plant cooling-water process representation jointly considered with power-system operation.
Fast cyber/information-layer sensing and its use with slower water/thermal/hydraulic dynamics for early warning or closed-loop control.
Extending physical-network service-loss analysis toward critical-facility, population, and social-vulnerability outcomes.

research_program.pilot_corpus_note: The current five PDFs are a pilot sample. Missing or zero D01-D10 labels are normal sample observations; they do not by themselves eliminate a research question or establish a field-wide absence.
